title: Frequency
note: always / usually / often / sometimes / never. Gap on the adverb. Position: before main verb, after be. sometimes also first/last. · 2026-08-29 smoke: intro five-word table + C8 sometimes-front; one Czech (D3); Use F3-trimmed onto freetime + be/have; questions stay Quiz/Type only; authored adverb chips.

items.explanation: always = every time. Before the verb: I **always** drink…
items.explanation_cz: always = vždycky. Před slovesem: I **always** drink…

items.explanation: always = every time. Before the verb: She **always** plays…
items.explanation_cz: always = vždycky. Před slovesem: She **always** plays…

items.en: I usually get up at seven.
accepts: I usually get up at seven.
I usually get up at seven o'clock.
items.explanation: usually = most of the time. Before the verb: I **usually** get up…
items.explanation_cz: usually = obvykle. Před slovesem: I **usually** get up…

items.en: We usually eat lunch at home.
accepts: We usually eat lunch at home.
We usually have lunch at home.
items.explanation: usually = most of the time. Before the verb: We **usually** eat…
items.explanation_cz: usually = obvykle. Před slovesem: We **usually** eat…

items.explanation: often = many times. Before the verb: I **often** watch…
items.explanation_cz: often = často. Před slovesem: I **often** watch…

items.explanation: often = many times. Before the verb: He **often** plays…
items.explanation_cz: often = často. Před slovesem: He **often** plays…

items.explanation: sometimes = not always. Before the verb, or first: **Sometimes** I go…
items.explanation_cz: sometimes = někdy. Před slovesem, nebo na začátku: **Sometimes** I go…

items.explanation: sometimes = not always. Before the verb, or first: **Sometimes** she works…
items.explanation_cz: sometimes = někdy. Před slovesem, nebo na začátku.

items.explanation: never = no time. Positive verb: I **never** drink… (not *don't never*)
items.explanation_cz: never = nikdy. Kladné sloveso: I **never** drink… (ne *don't never*)

items.explanation: never = no time. Positive verb: He **never** eats… (not *doesn't never*)
items.explanation_cz: never = nikdy. Kladné sloveso: He **never** eats… (ne *doesn't never*)

items.cz: Oni se nikdy nedívají na televizi.
items.explanation: never = no time. Positive verb: They **never** watch… (not *don't never*)
items.explanation_cz: never = nikdy. Kladné sloveso: They **never** watch… (ne *don't never*)

items.explanation: always = every time. After *be*: I am **always** tired.
items.explanation_cz: always = vždycky. Po *be*: I am **always** tired.

items.explanation: usually = most of the time. After *be*: She is **usually** happy.
items.explanation_cz: usually = obvykle. Po *be*: She is **usually** happy.

items.explanation: often = many times. After *be*: He is **often** angry.
items.explanation_cz: often = často. Po *be*: He is **often** angry.

items.explanation: sometimes = not always. After *be*, or first: **Sometimes** we are busy.
items.explanation_cz: sometimes = někdy. Po *be*, nebo na začátku.

items.explanation: never = no time. After *be*: I am **never** bored.
items.explanation_cz: never = nikdy. Po *be*: I am **never** bored.

items.explanation: often = many times. After *do*: Do you **often** travel? End is also fine: Do you travel **often**?
items.explanation_cz: often = často. Do you **often** travel? i Do you travel **often**?

items.explanation: always = every time. After *does*: Does she **always** work…?
items.explanation_cz: always = vždycky. Za *does*: Does she **always** work…?

items.en: I always go to the gym.
accepts: I always go to the gym.
items.explanation: always = every time. Before the verb: I **always** go…
items.explanation_cz: always = vždycky. Před slovesem: I **always** go…

items.explanation: never = no time. Positive verb: We **never** eat… (not *don't never*)
items.explanation_cz: never = nikdy. Kladné sloveso: We **never** eat… (ne *don't never*)

items.explanation: usually = most of the time. Before the verb: They **usually** speak…
items.explanation_cz: usually = obvykle. Před slovesem: They **usually** speak…

items.explanation: often = many times. Before the verb: I **often** read…
items.explanation_cz: often = často. Před slovesem: I **often** read…

items.explanation: never = no time. Positive verb: She **never** drinks… (not *doesn't never*)
items.explanation_cz: never = nikdy. Kladné sloveso: She **never** drinks… (ne *doesn't never*)

items.explanation: always = every time. After *be*: Are you **always** busy?
items.explanation_cz: always = vždycky. Po *be*: Are you **always** busy?

cards.title: The scale
points: **I never drink tea.** (no time; *never* already says no)
From every time to no time.

cards.title: Two places
points: Before the verb: **He often plays football.**
*sometimes* can also go first: **Sometimes I go to Brno.**

points: The adverb has two places. *never* is already no.
